# video35 - L1 proxy reconstruction (CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline)

Representation level: L1 (simple geometric proxies). Protocol: Three.js sampled-frame baseline with native render-inspect-revise rounds; not equivalent to Blender model rankings.

## Interpretation of the 24 reference samples (observed)
- Single continuous first-person shot (no cuts), 7.7 s at 60 fps, with a white centre HUD dot.
- 0.0-2.3 s: camera walks down a dark night alley alongside a red brick wall (left), with an illuminated fascia band at the top of the wall, a grey paving walkway, and lit concrete-block walls ahead/right. A white door stands open (~90 deg, outward) at the far end of the brick wall, facing the camera.
- 2.3-4.0 s: camera approaches the door and turns left into the doorway (open door on the right).
- 4.0-4.7 s: inside a dim storage room: stacked cardboard boxes, the black back of a drink cooler with lit shelves, a teal cart at the far end; camera keeps turning left (~180 deg total).
- 4.7-6.3 s: camera walks toward an inner doorway whose door is opened into the storage room (hinged on the right), with an ethanol box stack on the left and the cooler rack to the right; the bright store is visible through it.
- 6.3-7.7 s: camera enters the brightly lit convenience store (white ceiling with light panels, cyan hanging signs, open refrigerated case on the left wall, cup-noodle gondola, colourful gondola, freezer chests, dark right wall with posters, drink fridges) and pans right.

## Geometry / articulation
Boxes, cylinders and spheres only; procedural DataTextures for brick, block wall, product shelves. Two doors are separate hinged parts (entry door static open, inner door opened ~100 deg); both appear open in every sample, so no door motion is animated (inferred).

## Camera / timing
Camera eye 1.5 m, vertical FOV 60 deg, pitch about -3 deg. Position and heading are keyframed at the 24 sample times from estimated geometry (door image sizes, vanishing points) and interpolated with monotone cubic Hermite curves; a small walking bob is added. Positions between samples are inference.

## Feedback / revisions
Initial round: no render feedback yet. Lighting levels (ambient, camera flashlight spotlight, emissive store materials) are unverified guesses; the store layout is a coarse inference from a moving camera.

rounds.reason: Fix storage-room camera path and rack placement, re-derive store layout and in-store camera, darken brick.
